sourceRequest: 헐 내가 잘못말했었네,,, quant scout는 지금 우리 작업과 전혀 관련이 없는데 말이야.... 아무튼 analyst 보완 관련해서 최종목표를 달성할 수 있게 개선해줘
outcome: Improve the actual Analyst daily brief content quality, validate a newly frozen real-source edition and prepare safe preview release toward useful scheduled Slack delivery.
constraints: Company repository only; preserve research provenance
Official subscription runtime only; no paid API or unsandboxed fallback
Use frozen pre-cutoff registered originals and existing market data; no retrospective current lake or search backfill
Preserve stable model request IDs and uncertain receipts; at most one confirmed editorial repair
Keep Slack publication disabled until real content, preview, five-day timing and acceptance gates pass

deliverables.description: Correct observed forecast-versus-realized and missing economic-mechanism failures
acceptance: Source-supported temporal claims and corporate mechanism in writer/reviewer contract
Real 20-source review request remains within 88000 characters

deliverables.description: Evaluate a previously unused pre-cutoff original-source edition
acceptance: Freeze case and policy before inspecting original titles/content
Real source plan, writer and reviewer receipts with no more than one confirmed repair
Independent original-to-visible-main audit and honest failure/pass record

deliverables.description: Prepare a safe path for operational preview
acceptance: Read-only installed-release policy and role/channel check
Document exact remaining publication gates and do not claim deployment or Slack delivery without receipts

decisionGates: Full content qualification requires all twelve semantic checks, zero mechanical rejection and independent original-to-main audit on a freshly frozen edition.
A protected preview release uses the installed company release contract; no bypass of protected-file approval.
Automatic Slack publishing requires app/channel validation, live preview, recent five trading days, actual delivery receipts and human content review.
nonGoals: Quant Scout or research feed work
Trading, orders, backtests, training or portfolio allocation
Reclassifying earlier same-source development repairs as fresh acceptance
stopConditions: An uncertain model/Slack effect remains unreplayed with a new ID
Unavailable historical originals or operating prerequisites are recorded, not silently backfilled
